utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Morning, everyone. Wednesday, 29 April. Can you all hear me? Right, let's get going.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Yeah, loud and clear. Anyone watch the football last night? Honestly, what was that second half?

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: I switched it off. Had enough disappointment for one evening.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: And now the broken coffee machine in the canteen. Can't even recover properly. Just having a moan, before that goes on the job list.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: The instant stuff's still there. Technically coffee.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: After that traffic on the ring road, I'd drink anything. Twenty minutes barely moving.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Right, before we become a breakfast radio show—process update?

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: Yeah so, tested the turbine one gas valve yesterday and it's all fine now. That's finished.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Lovely. That's the one we'd been waiting to hear about.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: Yep. And I signed off the inspection on the Line 1 Mould Temperature Controller on Tuesday. Also done, not carrying that forward.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Good, both closed then.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: One observation: saw the pressure on the GT2 dip for a few minutes, it came back on its own.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Right, so a transient, rather than something still sitting low?

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: Exactly. Just mentioning what I saw, not raising another job today.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: And the supplier still hasn't confirmed the delivery for the IM2. That's still blocked, just a status update.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Yeah, no confirmed delivery date. Nothing firmer than that, unfortunately.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Fiona, can you investigate the pressure drop on the water booster today? That's holding production up so it needs doing first.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Yes, I'll investigate the pressure drop on the water booster today. First thing ahead of my other bits.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: And that's separate from my GT2 observation, just so we don't muddle the two.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Yep, understood. The water booster is the production hold-up; that's my first job.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Exactly, thanks.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: While I'm on, I'll write up the near miss at the main conveyor by Thursday.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Sorry, talked over you there—the written account of the near miss?

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Yeah, the write-up. I'll have that done by Thursday.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Thanks. Fiona Doyle against that one, then. Keeping it separate from the pressure drop.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: That's me, yes. Both mine, water booster first.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Han, can you sort the training records for the new starters, whenever you get a chance?

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Yeah, I'll sort the training records for the new starters.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: That's not something you're needing ahead of everything else, is it?

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: No, whenever you get a chance. There's no fixed deadline on that one.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Fine, understood. I'll fit that round the other work.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Jamie, on Friday can you book a contractor to look at the Stretch Wrapper? It matters but it's not urgent.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Yep—just checking, booking it on Friday, not promising the contractor will actually be here on Friday?

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: That's right. The booking on Friday. We're not setting their visit date here.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Okay, I'll book a contractor to look at the Stretch Wrapper on Friday. Important, but not an urgent call-out.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Good distinction. Booking a bloke and having a bloke stood next to it, very different things.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Quite. What else have we got?

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: I'll take vibration readings on the Line 3 Screw and Barrel tomorrow at 9:30.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Thanks, Jamie. Those readings—top priority please.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Yep, top priority. I'll take the readings tomorrow at 9:30.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Nine-thirty tomorrow, did you say? Teams clipped the end.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Tomorrow at 9:30, yeah. Line 3 Screw and Barrel.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: Heard it that time. Your microphone sounds like it's in a biscuit tin.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Tom, can you do the pre-use checks on the Forklift Fleet by the end of the week? It's urgent.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Sorry, before we move on—I can't get to the forklifts until production gives us a window. That's still the access blocker.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Understood. Yes, I'll take the pre-use checks on the Forklift Fleet, by the end of the week. I know it's urgent; access is the snag.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Right, the checks stay urgent and due by the end of the week. The access blocker is noted; we haven't got a window to promise here.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Yeah, agreed. They're my checks. I'm not calling them checked when I haven't been able to get at them.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Exactly. Just wanted that limitation clear, not another job added under my name.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: And I'll order spare parts for the guard switch on two by end of day. Low priority, that one.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Low priority for the spare parts order, yeah? Not saying a guard switch doesn't matter.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Yeah, the spare parts order is low priority. I'll still get it ordered by end of day.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Thanks, Hannah. Spare parts for the guard switch on two, by end of day, low priority. Got it.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Yep, that's mine.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Just checking my order of play: water booster today, first because it's holding production up. Near miss at the main conveyor written up by Thursday.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: That's right. The production hold-up comes first for you.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: And mine's urgent Forklift Fleet pre-use checks, by the end of the week, with that access issue still there. Clear.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: I've got top-priority vibration readings tomorrow at 9:30, and the Stretch Wrapper contractor booking on Friday. Not an urgent call-out.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Mine's the training records whenever I get a chance, and the low-priority spare parts order by end of day. All clear.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: Nothing else from me. The two completed bits are completed, and GT2 was just the observation.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Nothing further electrically. Just that forklift access blocker, as said.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Okay. IM2 delivery is still unconfirmed as well, not a fresh action out of this meeting. That's the work covered.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Lovely. Off to enjoy a cup of technically coffee.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Don't read the ingredients. Ruins the mystery.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: On that inspiring note—thanks, everyone. Speak later.
